notes: Notes can now be placed on two drawings at once: right-click a note and choose Place on Another Drawing. Clicking a linked note shows both drawings side by side, and a change to one copy changes the other. Sets are now kept for each job (Takeoff > Sets): the app finds every set on the drawings, numbers it and asks for it to be decided. A template's Rule for Claude is now a card with checks that Claude must answer at every fitting it places.
